title: calophyllum spectabile var. diepenhorstii
intro: Calophyllum spectabile var. diepenhorstii, commonly known as the Diepenhorst's Calophyllum, is a plant species in the family Calophyllaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various ailments. The Diepenhorst's Calophyllum has been reported to possess health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing, skin infections, and other conditions. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include calophyllolide, a sesquiterpene lactone with reported therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
